train.prompt: Write a design plan (not full code) for a climbing-gym class booking page. Include a named palette with hex values, type pairing, ASCII wireframe, and one signature element. State the subject, audience, and the page's single job.

Write a design plan for an independent record shop's used-vinyl listing page. Ground tokens in the subject. Include palette hex values, display vs body typefaces, and a signature the page will be remembered by.

held_out.prompt: Write a design plan for a community radio station's live-show schedule. Avoid cream/terracotta, black/acid-green, and broadsheet-as-decoration defaults unless you justify them from the brief. Include palette hex values and a signature.
